verdict.rationale: OpenAI's Batch API lets users send asynchronous groups of requests in bulk, with 50% lower cost, a separate pool of higher rate limits, and a 24-hour turnaround. Batch is also confirmed in pricing, rate-limits and capability-flag docs. missing for 10: details of batch job submission, input format, item limits and status/result retrieval, plus any independent hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: send asynchronous groups of requests with 50% lower costs, a separate pool of significantly higher rate limits, and a clear 24-hour turnaround time
